heading: 8 ingredients. 1 compounded capsule.
activeIngredientsLabel: Active Ingredients: finasteride 1mg, minoxidil 5mg, D-biotin, vitamin C, methyltetrahydrofolate, vitamin D3, zinc picolinate, and vitamin A, in a compounded liposomal capsule for absorption.

ingredients.name: Finasteride 1mg
ingredients.body: May block type II 5-alpha reductase; may lower DHT by approximately 70%.*

ingredients.name: Oral Minoxidil 5mg
ingredients.body: May support hair growth by increasing blood flow to the follicles and extending the growth phase of the hair cycle.*

ingredients.name: D-Biotin
ingredients.body: May support keratin production and overall hair health.*

ingredients.name: Vitamin Complex
ingredients.body: Vitamins C, D3, A, folate, and zinc to support follicle health.

safety.title: Common side effects
safety.body: Decreased libido, erectile dysfunction, decreased semen volume, breast tenderness or enlargement, mood changes, and minoxidil-related side effects such as fluid retention, dizziness, or unwanted body hair growth.

safety.title: Tell your healthcare provider
safety.body: Share any history of liver disease, prostate conditions, low blood pressure, heart conditions, current prescriptions, and any plans for blood donation while on finasteride.

safety.title: Do not use if
safety.body: You are a woman or a child. Finasteride is a medication for men only. Women who are or may become pregnant should never handle finasteride-containing medications.

safety.title: Seek medical care
safety.body: Severe allergic reaction (rash, swelling, trouble breathing), persistent breast changes, severe mood changes, dizziness or fainting, or signs of high-grade prostate disease.
